product_name: Handmade Leather Belt Pouch, EDC Coin & Card Holder

visual_observations: The pouch appears to have a rich brown leather finish.
It has a rectangular body with a rounded flap and visible contrasting edge stitching.
Two round metal fasteners are visible on the front flap.
A leather belt loop is visible on the back, shown attached to a belt.
ai_result.long_description:
Keep coins, cards, money, keys, a pocket knife and other small everyday essentials close at hand with this handmade leather belt pouch. Made from high-quality Italian vegetable-tanned leather, it is completely hand sewn and 100% handmade.

The compact design is suited to everyday carry, city walks and travel. The pouch measures 3.94 inches (100 mm) high × 3.94 inches (100 mm) wide × 1.57 inches (45 mm) deep. Its belt loop fits standard belts up to 1.96 inches (up to 5 cm) wide.

A practical EDC accessory and a thoughtful gift for a father, brother or friend, this small leather pouch is designed to keep frequently used essentials organized and accessible.
